context: Follow the amended docs/operations/github-org-transfer.md. G0: admin:org, 2FA, PAT policy, Actions allow-all; optional org challenge TXT add without Verify; keep _github-pages-challenge-joeharris76 TXT; do not change apex A/AAAA. Snapshot Pages API (cname, protected_domain_state, HTTPS) and curl 200 before G4. G4 transfer. G5 rebuild plus serving check. Then org-verify; if GitHub refuses because the user still holds verification, remove user verification only after the repo is already in the org and apex is 200. Update www.benchbox.dev CNAME from joeharris76.github.io to BenchBox-dev.github.io only after G4. Serving 200 is not publish-path proof.
description: Operator-only gates G0 and G2-G5, with Pages domain cutover AFTER transfer. Harden org BenchBox-dev (no org Pages Verify of benchbox.dev), dual-register PyPI publishers, freeze, transfer, rebuild hosted state, then confirm https://benchbox.dev/ still 200. Org-verify benchbox.dev only after G4. Keep user-account Pages verification until then. Do not enable merge queue. Blocked until written GO after G0+G1 (including 00b runbook amendment)+G2.

anti_patterns.dont: Click Verify for benchbox.dev on org BenchBox-dev while the repo is still user-owned
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD Leave user-account verification in place until after G4 and a live 200
anti_patterns.why: GitHub Pages domain verification is exclusive and a successful org verify immediately releases other accounts Pages bindings

anti_patterns.dont: Complete this TODO from an agent session without written operator GO
anti_patterns.instead: Leave the item blocked until the human org admin records GO
anti_patterns.why: Completing an operator-gated TODO without its gate is a defect

anti_patterns.dont: Create a new repository at joeharris76/BenchBox after transfer
anti_patterns.instead: Leave the old name as a redirect
anti_patterns.why: Recreating it permanently kills redirects that published wheels depend on

anti_patterns.dont: Delete the joeharris76 Pages challenge TXT or change apex A/AAAA before transfer
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD Keep serving DNS; apex already points at GitHub Pages IPs
anti_patterns.why: those records are what keep https://benchbox.dev serving today
Queue is a separate later decision

anti_patterns.dont: Point www.benchbox.dev at BenchBox-dev.github.io before the repo lives in the org
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD Retarget www only after G4 if needed
anti_patterns.why: the org has no Pages site until transfer

anti_patterns.dont: Treat merged G1 PRs as unfinished operator work
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD Start at G0/G2/G3 on the current develop tip
